name: Solenne Laceveil Spire Evening Glove
description:
Opera-length evening gloves designed for Spire galas and corponation function circuits. Constructed from bioluminescent silk-analog with a sheer gossamer overlay of hand-knotted synthetic lace in a pattern derived from Andean and West African textile traditions — no single source, everything fused. The glow is tunable via a micro-node at the inner wrist: resting pulse, static shimmer, or full dark depending on the room.

The upper arm portion is cut with a wide slit and concealed magnetic closure, allowing the glove to be worn over or alongside chrome upper arm housings without bunching. Available in midnight teal, bone white, and void black.
functionality: Tunable bioluminescent glow via wrist micro-node. Magnetic slit closure accommodates chrome upper arm or forearm augmentation. Moisture-resistant inner lining prevents staining from condensation or skin oils during extended wear.
what_it_says: You are dressed by someone who knows your body's exact geometry — chrome, geneware, and all — and made it look like it was always meant to glow.
story_hooks: A pair of these gloves was left behind at a Spire function where a senior executive collapsed — the gloves are registered to someone who wasn't on the guest list.
The bioluminescent dye in a recent Solenne batch reacts unexpectedly to a specific CorpSec UV scanning frequency, briefly illuminating concealed sub-dermal implants.
A Tier 3 forger has produced near-perfect replicas sold to aspiring social climbers — the tell is a slightly wrong glow frequency that Spire regulars clock immediately.

physical_description.visual_profile: Elegant opera-length gloves extending from fingertips to mid-upper arm, creating an elongated silhouette of refined luxury. The sheer lace overlay catches light with subtle iridescence, while the bioluminescent base layer provides an ethereal glow beneath. The wide slit at the upper arm creates an intentional asymmetry that reads as deliberately avant-garde rather than functional.
physical_description.fit: Precision-tailored through the hand and forearm with a gentle compression that accommodates subcutaneous augmentations without visible distortion. The upper arm section is intentionally loose and draped, with the magnetic closure creating a seamless integration over chrome housings. The slit allows independent movement of arm augmentations.
physical_description.primary_material: Bioluminescent silk-analog base with hand-knotted synthetic lace overlay; the silk-analog provides durability while maintaining the subtle luminosity required for Spire events
physical_description.texture: Smooth, cool silk-analog against skin with delicate raised texture from the gossamer lace overlay. The lace features intricate knotwork with micro-scale dimensionality that shifts under the bioluminescent glow. Hand-finished edges provide subtle tactile feedback.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in midnight teal (subtle blue-green with warm undertones), bone white (off-white with pearl luminescence), and void black (absolute matte with glow gradient at seams). The lace overlay in complementary ivory, charcoal, or gold-threaded variants depending on base color selection.
physical_description.closures: Concealed magnetic snap system at the upper arm slit, positioned to allow chrome or subcutaneous augmentations to pass through without interference. No visible hardware—closure is completely hidden within the fabric fold.
distinctive_features: Tunable bioluminescent micro-node at inner wrist with three settings: resting pulse (gentle heartbeat-rhythm glow), static shimmer (steady elegant illumination), full dark (manual override for stealth or preference)
Hand-knotted lace pattern synthesizing Andean geometric motifs and West African textile traditions into a singular non-appropriative fusion design
Intentional upper-arm slit with magnetic closure specifically engineered for chrome augmentation compatibility
Solenne Atelier logo subtly integrated into lace pattern at inner wrist—visible only to the wearer and intimates
Micro-ventilation perforations at palm and fingertips disguised within lace pattern to prevent moisture accumulation
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury; entry price point at 850 Φ, positioning it as achievable for established corpo professionals while remaining aspirational for Tier 3 climbers
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals wealth, cultural sophistication, and augmentation comfort—wearing these gloves broadcasts that you move in Spire circles, maintain corpo function credentials, and can afford bespoke augmentation-compatible fashion. The fusion textile pattern indicates education and appreciation for global aesthetic synthesis rather than colonial appropriation.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; with wear develops a subtle patina as the silk-analog gains character, though the lace remains structurally perfect due to synthetic durability. Some wearers prefer to replace after 2-3 seasons of gala rotation to maintain the bioluminescent node's peak efficiency.

image_prompt: High-fashion cyberpunk evening wear photography: Solenne Laceveil Spire Evening Glove displayed on the extended arm of a dark chrome mannequin or worn by an androgynous model with visible forearm augmentations. The glove glows softly in midnight teal, catching light through intricate hand-knotted lace overlay that reveals West African and Andean geometric patterns. Bioluminescent micro-node at wrist pulses gently. Shot against a moody GLMZ Spire backdrop—floor-to-ceiling windows framing distant city lights, warm accent lighting highlighting the lace texture and glow intensity.
